fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Send bell notifications to the Field Sales mobile app as push notifications

fields.label: Service Account Key File (.json)
fields.description: Firebase console → Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key, then upload the downloaded file here. It is stored encrypted and the uploaded copy is deleted.

fields.label: Firebase Project ID
fields.description: Taken from the uploaded key file

fields.options:
1. In the Firebase console, open the project the mobile app uses (the one its google-services.json came from).
  2. Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key.
  3. Upload the downloaded file above, tick Enabled and save.
  4. Use Send Test Notification to push to your own signed-in phones.
